K1–K5 are five identically worded account-recovery-standard hits, not five independent policies or one uniquely designated hit: ACC-STD-01 requires indistinguishable known/unknown reset responses and five requests per account per hour; ACC-STD-02 requires single-use links, 30-minute expiry, and revocation of every active session on reset; ACC-STD-03 requires notification after every successful reset.

**Coverage:** REQ-001 through REQ-024 are each linked above. No implementation, tests, or control-effectiveness evidence was supplied. Exact sign-in outcome/password policy, unknown-account request accounting, reset-page presentation/error text, and link delivery details remain open in the predecessor; mitigations must not silently establish unsupported policy.
